cuadrada.escena:

All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.
